messages:
maria: dropped a new prototype for key management flows, focused on revoke/undo, permission requests, and clear system-key warnings. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/DEF456 (see /revoke-undo & /perm-request). Need eyes on wording and keyboard behavior.

jess: nice! first pass: the undo toast currently times out in 5s. suggest making it 12s for slow keyboard users and include a 'Restore' button inside the toast.

ravi: agree on longer timeout. also recommend the toast use two actions: 'Restore' and a chevron menu for 'View audit entry'. keeps primary flow simple while allowing further investigation.

lee: a11y check: toast must be reachable via Tab and announced via assertive aria-live. If Restore is focused, pressing Enter should restore. Right now it's not tabbable in the prototype.

anya: copy nit for revoke confirmation: current copy "This action cannot be undone" is too alarmist when we have an undo window. propose: "This will revoke the key immediately. You can restore it within 14 days from the activity log." also add link: "Permanently delete now" for advanced users.

maria: good call. We'll standardize on 14 days. I'd like the wording to clearly differentiate 'revoke' vs 'soft-delete' in UI labels to avoid confusion. Maybe use: Revoke = immediate disable with undo; Delete = permanent.

oliver: security POV: for keys tagged 'infrastructure' or 'system', show an inline red banner in the modal: "System/infrastructure key. Rotating or revoking can interrupt services." require user to type the key name to confirm for those. checkbox alone is too weak for high-risk keys.

jess: typing-to-confirm is heavier but worth it for system keys. can we surface the affected services count too? not just a list but "X services, Y projects" summary with links.

ravi: dev comment: for batch revoke we should stream results: success / restored / failed per item and show a compact failure reason (friendly) with a 'Help' link that opens docs. No raw stack traces.

lee: keyboard flow for multi-select: after selecting 3+ keys and hitting 'Batch actions', focus should land on the modal title, not the modal close button. ensures users hear context. Also, when modal opens via keyboard, trap focus inside.

anya: permission gate UX: when a user lacks revoke permissions, instead of disabling the CTA, show a secondary inline affordance: "Request revoke access" which opens a small form prefilled with the key names and required scope. This should send a request to the admin and show an ephemeral confirmation to the requester. Avoiding dead-end disabled controls reduces support tickets.

maria: love that. we need to decide button microcopy. Options: "Request access" vs "Ask admin" vs "Request permission to revoke". Thoughts?

jess: "Request access" is short and matches other places in the console. Add tooltip that expands on which permissions will be requested.

oliver: for org admins, we should add a setting to auto-approve requests from owners of the project. reduce friction for small teams.

ravi: telemetry note: log whether request form was used and if it included multiple keys. Use that to prioritize improving the flow.

maria: mock update plan: - change undo window to 14d and toast timeout to 12s - toast tabbable + aria-live assertive - change copy: Revoke vs Delete distinction - add confirm-by-typing for system/infrastructure keys - add 'Request access' inline flow with prefilled modal - show impacted services summary collapsed by default. I'll push updates tonight.

ops-bot: Reminder: staging deploy queued for feature/keys-ux/undo-requests -> staging (build 488).

lee: I'll run accessibility smoke tests after staging is up and report back if focus or announcements fail.

maria: thanks all. tagging @oliver for final confirmation on typing-to-confirm text.

oliver: confirmed copy to require full key name and text: "Type the key name to confirm revocation: <KEY_NAME>". If user lacks visibility of full name, fallback to 'I understand the impact' checkbox for service accounts.

maria: perfect. will update Figma and leave a note on the component for devs about focus order and aria attributes. Pinged when ready. :raised_hands:
